work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCXXXVII to the archbishop of Lucca (address LF40247–40248, protocol LF40251) reorders the ecclesiastical patrimony of the duchy of Lucca in six numbered articles (I–VI, LF40347–40432), regulates debts, pensions, the Viareggio foundation, the archive under Fr Tommaso Pastrini and a one-year deputation, and ends with derogations and its own 21 June 1833 closing at LF41038–41041, before numeral CCXXXVIII at LF41044. Its article numerals I (40347), IT. (40356), Il. (40369), IV. (40385), VY. (40414) and VI. (40423) are retained as source article numbers. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF40251–40251; the source closing at LF41038–41041 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima prima iunii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pontificatus Nostri anno tertio. The foot-note block LF40286–40289 holds note 1 (Ex Bullario Romano, of CCXXXVI) and note 2 (Ex eodem Bullario, this letter's own provenance). The isolated glyph . at LF40388 between article IV. and its text is retained literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
